move.subject: Seal 24 mm (part 340010): firm two-year package for full allocation
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We understand capacity is tight and that you prioritise firm, long-term commitments. We therefore propose one complete package:

- EUR 29.89/unit
- 23,400 pcs/year, binding for both years
- 24-month term
- 54-day lead time, as you quoted
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling

We are offering a firm two-year commitment and keeping your quoted delivery window. In exchange, we ask for full allocation at this price.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Could you support this complete package?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your proposal for a 24-month term and an increased volume of 23,400 units per year. In recognition of this commitment, we can revise our price to EUR 31.70 per unit. As our production capacity remains highly utilised, this is a substantial concession.

Our modified Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Proposed package: 36 months at full volume
move.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for offering the full 23,400 pcs/year. We propose one complete package to conclude:

- EUR 31.07/unit
- 23,400 pcs/year, binding for each contract year
- 36-month term
- 54-day lead time, as you quoted
- Payment 30 days net, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause, no tooling

This raises our proposed price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.07/unit. It also adds a third binding year, so you can plan your capacity on three years of firm volume.

If you can accept this complete package, we would conclude on it.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
